title: Stasis
description: A triptych of cartoon figures showing one bald man in a white shirt and black shorts in three sequential falling poses against bright pink backgrounds, mounted on a textured white canvas. The entire piece is layered over large stenciled black text reading STASIS on a vibrant hot pink painted surface.
prompt: A mixed media painting featuring three sequential panels of a bald cartoon man wearing a white t-shirt and black shorts, shown in progressive stages of falling: standing and reacting, mid-air upside down, and lying on the ground. The panels have bright pink backgrounds and are mounted on a textured white canvas. Large stenciled black letters spelling STASIS appear behind the panels on a vibrant hot pink painted surface with visible brushstrokes and layered translucent sheets.
